premise: I invested my entire $90,000 factory pension to co-develop a patented organic composting system with my brother-in-law on a 50/50 handshake, but he forged my relinquishment of rights, filed a sole patent, and landed a $600,000 city contract under a new LLC; I proved the forgery, won half the royalties and the LLC, then rebranded it ‘Composted Lies Inc.’—now I sell the system to the same city and donate a portion of profits to a forgery-detection nonprofit, listing him as ‘Inspirational Fraudster of the Year’ on every check.
